privacyIntroBody: CopyCoach AI ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI-powered copywriting coaching application and website.
privacyCollectIntro: We may collect the following types of information:
accountInformationText: Name, email address, and password when you create an account.
profileDataText: Brand voice preferences, target audience, and copywriting niche settings.
usageDataText: Copy text you submit for analysis, generated suggestions, and interaction patterns.
paymentInformationText: Processed securely through Paystack. We do not store card details.
deviceBrowserDataText: IP address, browser type, and device identifiers for analytics.
useProvideImprove: Provide and improve the CopyCoach AI service.
useAnalyzeTrends: Analyze usage trends to improve our AI models.
useDetectFraud: Detect and prevent fraud or abuse.
privacySharingBody: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with trusted third-party service providers (Supabase, Vercel, Paystack, AI model providers) solely to operate and improve our service. These providers are bound by confidentiality obligations.
privacySecurityBody: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacyRetentionBody: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your data at any time. Analyzed copy data may be retained in anonymized form for service improvement.
rightAccess: Access, correct, or delete your personal data.
rightExport: Export your data in a portable format.
rightOptOut: Opt out of non-essential data processing.
privacyCookiesBody: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. Analytics cookies may be used to understand how you interact with our service. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
privacyChildrenBody: CopyCoach AI is not intended for users under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacyChangesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacyContactBody: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our in-app support or email us at the address associated with your account.
deletionSubtitle: How to request deletion of your personal data
deletionRequestIntro: You can request deletion of your personal data at any time. We will process your request within 30 days.
deletionRequestMethods: To request data deletion, use any of the following methods:
deletionMethodInAppText: Go to Dashboard → Profile Settings → Support Hub and submit a deletion request.
deletionMethodEmailText: Send a deletion request from the email address associated with your account.
deletionWhatIntro: Upon successful deletion request, we will remove:
deletionRetainedIntro: The following may be retained in anonymized or aggregated form:
retainedAnalysis: Anonymized copy analysis data used for AI model improvement
retainedLegal: Records required by law or for fraud prevention
deletionSelfServiceBody: You can also delete your account directly from the app by navigating to Dashboard → Profile Settings → Account section and selecting "Delete Account." This action is irreversible.
deletionContactBody: For any questions about data deletion, please reach out through our in-app support channel.
